summary: Electra Battery Materials Corp filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the engagement of Douglas Geniti as Senior Advisor, Commercial Strategy. Mr. Geniti, a veteran cobalt and nickel trader formerly with Sumitomo Corporation of the Americas, will support the company's commercial planning as it advances construction of its North American cobalt sulfate refinery. The filing contains no special-situation transaction metrics, deal terms, or corporate actions; it is a routine operational announcement regarding a commercial team appointment.
